statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail sits in the low band at 16% while Stress holds elevated at 50%, with conditional risk concentrated in the September quadruple-witching settlement rather than in observed intraday structure.
recommendation: NQ trades near 29,794, roughly 172 points below the 29,966.75 session high and 146 above the 29,648.00 low, so the retracement mechanism is functioning and Tail remains well below the block threshold through the US cash open. Conditional risk is concentrated in the 19:00Z-20:15Z window around the quadruple-witching settlement, with the Schmid speech at 15:45Z as an intermediate checkpoint.
headline: NQ holds about 29,794 in mid-range after August industrial production came in unchanged and manufacturing fell 0.3%, with the 29,966.75 high unretaken, VIX at 15.41 and the 10-year back near 4.98% on quadruple-witching Friday
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed Thursday at 29,446.98, up 1.73%, extending the relief rally that followed Wednesday's unanimous Federal Reserve decision to raise the target range to 3.75-4.00%, the first US increase in more than three years, with further tightening signalled for later this year. NQ futures print about 29,794 against a 29,743.00 previous close, roughly +0.17%, inside a 29,648.00-29,966.75 band. The structural read is unchanged from the previous hour and is the reason Tail stays low: the 29,966.75 high has now stood unretaken for more than four hours, price gave back the large majority of the day's advance and has since stabilised near the middle of the band rather than extending. That is a functioning retracement mechanism and the direct opposite of the shallow-pullback, repeated-extension path this score measures. The US cash open has passed without opening-auction continuation to new highs, which removes the specific amplifier that has historically preceded the strategy's worst sessions. August industrial production printed at 13:15Z and was soft: total output unchanged against a 0.3% consensus, manufacturing output down 0.3%, and capacity utilisation at 76.3%, verified directly from the Federal Reserve G.17 release. A soft growth print under a tightening Fed cuts both ways and has so far produced dispersion rather than direction. Cross-assets do not form an amplifier stack. VIX trades 15.41 in a 14.99-15.61 band against a 17.71 previous close, so the post-decision volatility crush is intact. The 10-year yield is 4.982%, up about 3.5 basis points and the one genuine conflict in the picture, after H.15 put the 2-year and 10-year constant maturities at 4.74% and 5.01% on 16 September. Crude is mixed, with WTI near 102.90 dollars, up about 1%, while Brent eases 0.39%, as reporting that Saudi Arabia's damaged East-West pipeline could restart within days offsets the unresolved US-Iran conflict. Stress is held at 50% because today is September quadruple-witching expiry, with index futures, index options and single-stock options settling at the 20:00Z cash close on volumes historically several times a normal session, and because a Fed speaker follows at 15:45Z. Those are checkpoints that raise Stress and dispersion, not observed Tail. Confidence is 88% on two independent live futures quotes agreeing within 2.5 points, a primary-source verification of the industrial production release, current VIX, yield and oil levels, and a verified seven-day calendar. The shared Finviz context file was 92 minutes old and marked partial, with its futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it was outside the freshness window and was not used as evidence for this assessment; independent research covered the same ground.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Tail ranged 15-26% and Stress decayed from 57% into the low 40s overnight before rebuilding to 49% through the European morning. The single orange hour was 13:00Z Thursday at the US cash open, where trend-up structure was most pronounced; Tail fell back through Thursday afternoon as retracements reappeared. From 22:00Z the overnight hours settled into a normal, range-bound regime with Tail 17-18%, and that regime held through the Bank of Japan decision and the Ueda press conference without a disorderly repricing. The 07:00Z through 10:00Z hours carried a trend-up read as NQ pressed the top of its band, and the last two hours turned mixed as the session high was rejected and the majority of the day's advance was given back.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry one conditional-risk peak and a single hour mapped into the watch band. Tail is 16% for the current cash-open hour, edges to 18% at 14:00Z and 15:00Z around the opening-range resolution and the Schmid speech, then eases back through the early afternoon. It rises to 19% at 19:00Z for power hour and peaks at 21% at 20:00Z, where the September quadruple-witching expiration settles at the cash close and Stress reaches 60%; that is four points below the block threshold because expiry flow characteristically whipsaws rather than trends. From 21:00Z the CME weekend halt removes any live price path, so Tail falls to 11-14% and Confidence decays from the high band into the solid band across the remaining weekend slots, reaching 60% in the final hour.
